title: What are the qualifications of Occupational Therapists at Pinnacle?
metaTitle: Qualified Occupational Therapists at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Pinnacle Blooms Network has highly qualified and further trained Occupational Therapists excelling at providing therapy to children with autism and various developmental disorders.
html: We take pride in our team at Pinnacle Blooms Network. Our Occupational Therapists are all equipped with either a Bachelor's or a Master's degree in Occupational Therapy. However, that's not all, they are registered with relevant professional bodies and have undergone further training to deliver high-quality services to children with autism and other developmental disorders. Their acquired expertise makes them incredibly adept at understanding and addressing each child's unique needs and potentials.
